quarterly_data.quarter: M31 Technology press release: M31 and Ambiq Collaborate on TSMC N12e Foundation IP to (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: M31 and Ambiq announced a joint ultra-low-power Foundation IP solution on TSMC's N12e process (at the TSMC 2026 North America OIP Ecosystem Forum) for Ambiq's platforms, targeting AIoT, wearables and always-on edge applications. It pairs an N12e ULL (Ultra Low Leakage) SPSRAM memory compiler, whose dual-rail architecture achieves close to 500 MHz at near-threshold periphery voltage in low-power mode while keeping VCCA retention leakage within 1.05-1.1x of total bit-cell retention leakage (initial instances show PPA gains; full compiler development is ongoing), with an N12e standard-cell library that achieves approximately 50% leakage power savings through design-level collaboration with Ambiq. Ambiq's CTO said the collaboration contributed building blocks to Ambiq's next-generation flagship platform on TSMC N12e. No volumes or dates stated.
quarterly_data.figure: SPSRAM compiler close to 500 MHz at near-threshold voltage; approximately 50% leakage power savings (standard cells); full compiler development ongoing
